verdict.rationale: Each Hightouch sync connects one model to one destination and defines how fields map, so a privacy lead can choose which attributes reach each destination. The healthcare page also claims rules governing "where and how that data can get used." The evidence does not document any hashing or masking of PII, and it does not describe a dedicated PII-filtering control. Missing for 10: documented per-destination hashing, masking of sensitive attributes, an explicit PII field-filtering/governance feature, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes

citations.quote: A sync connects one model to one destination object, list, or table, and describes how the model's rows map into that destination.
Map fields between your source and destination.
Set robust rules to manage which users can access which data, and where and how that data can get used.
